SQUAREFREE SEMIPRIMES WITH RECIPROCAL SUM EXACTLY 2 (and one set with sum 3)
==============================================================================
Each example is a set of squarefree semiprimes n = p*q (p < q primes) with  sum 1/n = 2  EXACTLY.
Generated by semiprime_integers.py, verified by verify_semiprime_integer.py with exact integer /
rational arithmetic only (Fraction sum, both factors prime and distinct, p-adic criterion at every
prime). No floating point anywhere.

Lower bound: the 1233 smallest semiprimes have reciprocal sum < 2 (H_1233 < 2 <= H_1234), so at least
1234 terms are needed for the sum 2 (and 73736 for the sum 3). Minimality of the sets below is NOT claimed.

Sum 2: 31 distinct sets, sizes 2250 - 2552 (median 2397). Smallest: 2250 terms.
